label: TP
reason: User input from HTTP header flows through URL decode -> Base64 encode/decode roundtrip -> becomes String -> converted to bytes -> reconverted to String -> passed to encodeForHTML() -> written to response. The Base64 encoding/decoding does not sanitize HTML content (it preserves attacker payloads), and the final encodeForHTML() is applied to already-transformed data reaching the response sink.

evidence.note: header input flows through encoding/decoding pipeline to HTML sink
